title: Link created
description: The `201` answer of `POST /consent/links` (client authentication) to the relying party (protocol 1.2, spec section 14.3). `link_uri` is the link code the party shows as a QR code inside its own authenticated session; `binding_code` is shown next to it and typed on the phone.

link_uri.description: biatec-authenticator://link?iss=<issuer>&id=<link_id>&s=<link_secret>; `iss` is the percent-encoded issuer, `s` the base64url of 32 random bytes.
